title: 第12章 一切为了五百万
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

经过一天一夜的航行，陆地终于出现。

林北把船停在港口后，便押着被捆成粽子的亚尔丽塔下了船，身后还跟着三个小屁孩儿。

港口附近的行人和商贩纷纷投来畏惧的目光。

亚尔丽塔经常在这片海域活动，不少人都见过她的通缉令。

眼见一个年纪轻轻的毛头小子，领着三个半大的孩子就捉住了这样一个穷凶极恶的海贼，不少人纷纷发出惊叹。

“这年轻人，可真不得了。”

“骗人的吧？肯定是假冒的。”

“你小点声，别被他们听见。那年轻人看起来还蛮凶狠的。”

悠悠和惠惠是头一回来到这个世界，对周遭的一切都很好奇，一个个东张西望，看什么都新鲜。

“这个世界的蔬菜居然不用被关在笼子里？”

“就是说啊，这些小贩就不担心被蔬菜给杀掉吗？”

路飞倒是十分放松，随手从路边小摊上捞起一个水果就塞进嘴里。

“太奇怪了，那个水果居然就这么被吃掉了？”

“而且看起来还很好吃的样子……”

然而此刻的林北，比在场的任何人都要紧张。

最后一步，就差最后一步。

他在心里把满天神佛的名字全念叨了一遍，打定主意，不管遇到什么牛鬼蛇神，哪怕发生天大的事，都要不惜一切代价把赏金搞到手。

想到这儿，他瞥了一眼路飞。

这家伙，绝对是个定时炸弹。

以他的性格，只要被人问起来历，铁定会不管不顾地嚷嚷自己是海贼，要成为海贼王。

不行，绝不能让这家伙坏事。

“喂，路飞。”

“嗯？”

“你身为海贼，去海军基地总归不太好吧。”

“哎？你不也是海贼吗？”

林北面不改色，从怀里摸出一把纸币，塞到路飞手里。

这是他从亚尔丽塔船上缴获的战利品之一。

“……总之，这是一万贝利。你先去那边的酒馆吃点东西，等我办完事，会回来找你的。”

Page (1/3)

After a day and night of sailing, land finally appeared.

After Lin Bei parked the boat at the port, he escorted Arrita, who was tied into a rice dumpling, off the boat, followed by three little kids.

Pedestrians and traders near the port cast fearful glances.

Arrita often moves around this sea area, and many people have seen her wanted poster.

Many people were amazed when they saw a young boy leading three and a half-year-old children to capture such a vicious pirate.

"This young man is really incredible."

"Is it a lie? It must be a fake."

"Keep your voice down, don't let them hear you. That young man looks quite fierce."

It was the first time for Yuyou and Huihui to come back to this world. They were very curious about everything around them. They looked around and saw everything new.

“Vegetables in this world don’t need to be kept in cages?”

"That is to say, aren't these vendors worried about being killed by vegetables?"

Luffy was very relaxed. He picked up a piece of fruit from a roadside stall and stuffed it into his mouth.

"It's so strange. That fruit was eaten just like that?"

"And it looks delicious..."

However, at this moment, Lin Bei was more nervous than anyone present.

The last step, just the last step.

He recited the names of all the gods and Buddhas in the sky in his mind, and made up his mind that no matter what monsters, monsters, monsters, or monsters he encountered, or even if something big happened, he would get the bounty at all costs.

Thinking of this, he glanced at Luffy.

This guy is definitely a time bomb.

With his character, if someone asks him about his history, he will definitely say that he is a pirate and wants to become the Pirate King.

No, we must not let this guy do bad things.

"Hey, Luffy."

"Huh?"

"As a pirate, it's not good to go to a naval base."

"Hey? Aren't you a pirate too?"

Lin Beimian didn't change his expression, took out a handful of banknotes from his arms and stuffed them into Luffy's hand.

It was one of the trophies he captured from Arrita's ship.

"...Anyway, this is ten thousand beli. You go to the tavern over there to have something to eat first. I will come back to you when I finish my work."
